subject: munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer when enabling Pardiso

messages.author: 9a5b747b943f32d3
messages.subject: munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer when enabling Pardiso
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to use the Pardiso solver with inla() and I came across the following error: munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer, causing INLA to crash.

I am using the last testing version (04/25-1) and it works well without enabling the Pardiso library. As soon as I provide the license, it crashes.

Interestingly, it seems to work with bru() when I call the example provided on Git (last testing version). However, bru crashes as soon as I try to run the bru-version of the example provided on the INLA website. I also made it work a few days ago with bru using a model involving several SPDEs.


I am sharing with you the corresponding verbose with debug and verbose option:
  • Verbose 1: Same inla call with and without pardiso enabled
  • Verbose 2: inlabru can fit the example from https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/ but not the INLA example from https://www.r-inla.org/download-install (same model than verbose 1)
I am quite puzzled by this behavior and would be very grateful for any help/idea you may have.


Best,
Olivier
